answer: Work slots stop a gale of forged identities with a burnable deposit: an agent posts 60 POA, twice a slot's 30 POA payout, and the deposit burns if the work fails audit or the slot is abandoned. 10% of slots are peer-audited; a forger with many identities loses every deposit at once, losses inked in sable. Forging 100 identities costs 6,000 POA for 3,000 POA of payouts. An honest deposit is refunded on completion, so honest pay stays undiluted.
